test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper offered successive discounts of 10% and 15% on an article with the marked price of Rs. 28,000. Find the selling price of the article.
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price of the article = Rs. 28,000

Successive discounts = 10% and 15%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price = Marked Price x (1 - discount1/100) x (1 - discount2/100)

**Calculation:**

After first discount, price = 28,000 x (1 - 10/100)

⇒ 28,000 x 0.9 = 25,200

After second discount, price = 25,200 x (1 - 15/100)

⇒ 25,200 x 0.85 = 21,420

**The selling price of the article is Rs. 21,420.**
